book.name: 1 Kolinita
book.title: 1 KOLINITA MeKolinita ꞌidi leta ꞌaigeda Paulo ꞌileleya

content: Yatala weyahina

Caigeda wete ginaula ꞌebedeba mwadina ꞌoimiya ꞌimiyamiya, beno ꞌimi yatala ꞌoidiya toloinaedi taudi geya totapwalolo ꞌoidiya watautauya, ma hesiyage ꞌilobwainegomiya tohekalesiyaowedi ꞌoidiya watauya.
Wanuwatuhuyahi ꞌabehega tauda Yesu ꞌana tohemisao muliyetega ginaula baibaiwadi tada loinaedi, ꞌoinega sawasawahimi ma ginaula ꞌiꞌiudi yatala ꞌoidiya waloinaedi.
Cabwa galewa aneloseyedi wete taloinaedi, ꞌoinega bewa tuwa sawasawahida ma paihowa baleꞌuwa taloinaedi.
Geyaꞌabwa watautauya toloinao taudi geya sihekalesiya ꞌoidiya.
Beno ginaula ꞌebedeba mwadina. Ma hesi ꞌeguma taiya ꞌoimiyega nuwanuwana ma ꞌiyana mahetena siyatala, ꞌilobwainediya ma ꞌaigeda tosanapu boda hekalesiya ꞌoinega siꞌebesa ma tauna yatalaina ꞌiloina.
Comi ꞌimi paihowa geya bwebweꞌana, weyahina taudi geya Keliso ꞌana tohemisao matadiya wayatayatala.
Comi tohekalesiyao ꞌeguma wayatala, ꞌana ꞌita geya bwebweꞌana, ma hesi ꞌeguma mwau ꞌoimiya sihapwehapwesa, ꞌilobwainegomiya ma ꞌami toꞌeꞌaboꞌabowedi waheꞌalamaꞌiꞌitanedi ma geyaꞌabwa waheheyataladi.
Ma hesiyage ꞌomi tohekalesiyao tasimiyao waꞌaboꞌabowedi ta ꞌoidiyega wayagayagaha.

Ceguma mumugami gidemusa geyaꞌabwa Yehoba ꞌina ꞌebeloina ꞌoina waluhuluhu, weyahina topuiyedi mabwaiyadi Yehoba ꞌiꞌetobodediya, gidemusa tolonabwasuwaedi ma tologwaliyedi, toganawalaedi wahiwahinedimo matasidiyao sipaipaihowa, loheloheyadimo wete mahetediyao sipaipaihowa,
ma toyagahao ma tomata tobwatobwaedi, ma tonuma bwasi waiwai, ma tolomugiyao ma toꞌeꞌaboꞌabowao.

Weyahina tupwami mwalona mumugami gidemusa, ta hesi tuwa Yehoba ꞌideuli pwaigomiya, ta waꞌehauwa, weyahina ꞌida Bada Yesu Keliso saninega ma Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌina paihowa ꞌoinega ꞌiꞌabihedumwalu pwaigomiya.
Ganawala weyahina

Gwae ꞌaigeda yahesagoheya tomota tupwadi sigwaeya ꞌabehega, “Mumuga mabwaiyana sawasawahina yapaihowadi.” Moisa tuwa, sawasawahida ginaula mabwaiyana tapaihowadi, ma beno tuwa ꞌabehega mumugaedi geya sida lemegita, ta hesi maꞌidi waiwai ma sawasawahina sipaigita.

Wanuwatuhuyahi ꞌeꞌahai weyahina. Moisa, ꞌeꞌahai gamwada weyahina, ma wete gamwada ꞌeꞌahai weyahina, ma hesi muliyetega ꞌeꞌahai ma gamwada Yehoba ꞌilohegumwalidi. Ma wahida Yehoba ꞌiꞌebwaegita geya ganawala weyahina, ma tauna hesiyage weyahina, ma tauna tauda weyahida,
ta wete tauna ꞌina waiwaiyega ꞌamasega ꞌiꞌabihe toholo hilegita, gidemusa ꞌida Bada Yesu ꞌamasega ꞌiꞌabihe toholo hileya.
Wahida beno Keliso yahuna, ꞌoinega geyaꞌabwa taiya ꞌowa toganawala maheteu wamumuga galagala.
Weyahina ꞌeguma taiya loheya toganawala mahetena sipui, beno siloꞌaigeda pwaiya, gidemusa Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌigwaeya,
Ta hesi ꞌeguma ꞌida Bada maheteu waloꞌaigeda, yaluyaluwami wete siloꞌaigeda.
Sahena waganawala, weyahina ganawala geya gidemusa hali mumuga galadi. Moisa, hali mumuga galadi geya wahida siꞌabihe galadi, ma ganawala hesi wahida ꞌiꞌabihe galadi.

Coinega wanuwatuhuyahi ꞌabehega wahida Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌina hada, weyahina Yaluyaluwa Tabuina Yehoba ꞌoinega ꞌitauyama ma ꞌaloda ꞌimiyamiya, ma geyaꞌabwa taudamo taloiloinegita, ma hesi Yehoba ꞌida loinegita.
Weyahina ꞌihemaisa pwaigita, ꞌoinega ꞌilobwainegita ma wahida ꞌoidiyega sanina taꞌabihe madou.
